## Summary


## Test evidence

- [ ] Added or updated regression coverage.
- [ ] Recorded the exact commands and platforms actually tested.
- [ ] Documented expected skips, unavailable platforms, and remaining validation.

## Boundary review

- [ ] No credentials, signing material, proprietary SDKs/plugins, or copyrighted
      media are included.
- [ ] Software evidence is not presented as physical-hardware, accessibility,
      signing/notarization, legal, clean-host, or production qualification.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes remain fail closed and avoid exposing private
      logs, identifiers, or secrets.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and release documentation are updated when applicable.
